title: Introducing HYPE Staking on Gemini
summary: Gemini customers can now stake their HYPE tokens.
body_markdown:
Gemini is pleased to announce we now offer staking rewards on Hyperliquid (HYPE) in most US jurisdictions,* adding to the exchange’s growing list of staking products.


While much of the crypto market hit a bear market late last year, (HYPE) has continued to steadily increase in value, gaining more than 100% over the past year. It is the native and governance token for Hyperliquid, a provider of perpetual futures crypto trading. Gemini Exchange customers can now stake the token at an annual yield that currently stands at around 2.1%.


### About Gemini Staking


**No Minimums. No Transfer Fees.**


Customers can start staking with any amount. There are no minimums and no transfer or redemption fees associated with staking. Gemini’s service fee is automatically deducted from the rewards you earn, so there are no surprise charges.


**Consistent Rewards. On Your Terms.**


Gemini Staking is designed for steady rewards and a simple experience, with transparent reward tracking directly in the Gemini app.


[Try Gemini Staking today.](https://www.gemini.com/staking)


Onward and Upward!
Team Gemini


*Staking is available for Moonbase customers. It is not available in New York.
